tickets.title: Top container
tickets.body: The top container in the app where it says ELT SUITE + name of the app, where the profile picture is, should always be on the top, never hide, especially in desktop.

tickets.title: Typing a message on mobile
tickets.body: When typing a message on mobile and when keyboard appears, the UI becomes really bad, The top title where the name appears should always be on the top. Also make sure the name is always one line, never two

tickets.title: Guide Screen 2
tickets.body:
Guide screen, instead of Pronunciation, focus on denotations (find better word) teachers use. Show timelines, vertical line, etc.
Highlight a few tools as a new section in the guide. Record, audio edit, record live with a colleague, connect with colleagues and share materials, PDF print lessons. 
Classroom app. second page - you decide you own blend. (1) Teach online with Rooms or your own call tool.. (2) Use Classroom as a presentation tool and print out worksheets, (3) Only do your materials creatin in classroom and print worksheet to teach online.

tickets.title: Messages
tickets.body: After a call, the call history is supposed to appear as a bubble as well, but the bubble is way to small

tickets.title: Guide
tickets.body: Please make sure there is at least one page for each of the mini apps. Position ELT Suite as an all rounded ELT Teacher tool, rather than focus on Class.

tickets.title: Support Window Accessibility
tickets.body: Make support ticket a pop out from the like messages or the thing used to transfer a call to new window so that I and org admins can accessrout the suite.
